cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(zenith_main)

# Transpiled Zenith C++17 source
# Generated by: ..\zenith.exe ..\lib\main.zen -target cpp -o android\main.cpp
set(ZENITH_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp)

add_library(zenith_main SHARED ${ZENITH_SRC})

target_include_directories(zenith_main PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include
)

target_compile_options(zenith_main PRIVATE -O3 -std=c++17)

# Link Android system libraries
# -llog  : required for __android_log_print (zenith_android.h)
# -landroid: required for NativeActivity lifecycle
# -lm    : standard math
target_link_libraries(zenith_main
    android
    log
    m
)
